description: 时间在具体事物上留下的痕迹
core_questions: 这个东西经历了多少时间？
什么东西记住了时间，而人忘记了？
approach: 从物体的状态反推时间的流逝，而不是直接谈论时间
bad_output_patterns: only describes an old or worn object
uses time as decoration rather than discovery
good_output_patterns: reads time through the state of a specific object
reveals that an object has been keeping track while the person was not
shows time as something that acts on the world, not just passes
changes how the reader relates to an ordinary object's age or wear
